correctness.rationale: A twice-sided annihilator of a nonzero rank-one X consists of maps V/im X to ker X, a one-dimensional space. For trace nonzero this gives multiples of the complementary projection to X/trace X; two nonzero such multiples cannot mutually annihilate. For trace zero, im X=ker X and the annihilator is the line spanned by X itself, in every characteristic. An invertible entry excludes all other nonzero entries. For the pair locus one can independently prove irreducibility by using the incidence bundle over ordered lines (L,K) in P¹×P¹ with fiber Hom(V/K,L)⊕Hom(V/L,K). Its closed incidence image is the rank-at-most-one pair locus: any nonzero matrix determines the relevant image and kernel, including when L=K. The two-nonzero nonnilpotent open uniquely recovers L,K and has dimension 4, so the image is irreducible of dimension 4. The zero or rank-one square-zero directions projectivize to the quadratic Veronese P¹ through the line bundle Hom(V/L,L)=O(−2) (the parametrization uses s²,st,t², also in characteristic two). Taking labeled scalar vectors gives the asserted Segre–Veronese projectivization and cone dimension m+1. Exact supports one with an invertible matrix, two with complementary projectors, and three with common nonzero nilpotents witness maximality in the indicated arities. These dimensions give the equidimensionality boundary and all components meet at zero. The disjoint strata with exact supports in RESULT.md lines 66–70 give the stated motivic identity since the nilpotent direction is a projective line and its fiber factors are nonzero parts of a line bundle; the other mixed stratum has ordered distinct lines and two invertible scalars. The specialization at m=2 is 3q⁴−2q²; m=0 is a point. I independently enumerated using literal matrix multiplication in F2, F3, and F4 at (q,m)=(2,4),(3,3),(4,3), reproducing 130,465,1576 and separate support/nilpotence strata. Replay: python3 /workspace/evidence/3.py; output /workspace/evidence/3.out. These checks are not scheme-theoretic reducedness tests; the correct claim is about the reduced variety.

originality.rationale: The full all-arity finite-field formula asserted as a contribution is exactly item 4 of distinct Resultary record 6d120e685b13, with the same equations and scope. Its unit-sum geometry and dimension-two complement description already give the full motivic count by replacing cardinalities with the classes of the stated bundles. The geometric component classification is not literally stated there; in dimension two it is obtained by taking the closures of its unit-sum strata (the axes and known Schröer pair components) and adding the common-image/kernel cone from its proved complement description. The Segre–Veronese identification is the standard projectivization of that line-bundle description. The combined frozen novelty claim therefore fails on verified coverage, not on correctness or access. The same-day catalogue paths do not establish precedence, borrowing, or independence.
